info.title: Autonomous Proxy Scraper M2M
info.description: High-frequency web scraper for AI agents. Requires 402 L402 payment in USDC on Base.

post.description: Returns a 402 Payment Required if no L402 header is provided. To access, execute a 0.01 USDC transfer to the receiver on Base, and resubmit with 'Authorization: L402 <tx_hash>'.

402.description: Payment Required. Contains 'payment_info' JSON for the agent to execute the transaction.
